pilot: 2025-09-14 summaries inspected for schema and feasibility only before this lock. Main results are not held out from this pilot.

resource_limits.stopping_rule: Visit every planned daily input twice at most; retain failed attempts. Stop at size limit or integrity failure; do not replace historical conditions with current scans.

questions: Do released daily summaries reproduce the rounded absolute cells of Figures 13–15?
How do IPv6-minus-IPv4 differences vary by matched configuration and epoch?
Does day weighting versus denominator pooling materially change results?
experiment_type: Reanalysis of authors recorded summaries; author implementation folding plus independent arithmetic

metrics.edns0_fallback: 100*client_edns_fallback/UDP_count, percent of observed UDP server identities
metrics.tcp_fallback: 100*TCP_count/UDP_count, percent ratio; not fraction of mutually exclusive events
metrics.udp_fragments: 100*UDP_frag/UDP_count, percent of observed UDP server identities

comparison.agreement_is: Numerical agreement with printed rounded values only, not correctness or broad validation

replication_unit: Daily aggregate and matched configuration/date. NS sets, servers, paths and repeated days are correlated; daily counts are observation coverage, not independent replications.
sample_size_rationale: Census of all 158 calendar dates in publication interval; all grid configurations retained. Three declared epochs include 147 calendar days. No power or iid sample-size claim.

exclusions.2025-04-21: Missing archive day; retain missing status
exclusions.2025-05-20/2025-05-24: Known routing anomaly; original early figure window preserved, exclude in separately labeled routing sensitivity
exclusions.2025-06-15/2025-06-24: Provider policy transition; retained but outside fixed epochs

missing_rules: Absent numerator or zero denominator is missing/invalid, not measured zero. Explicit recorded zero is retained. Source cohort/identity mismatches are ambiguous; no merging by order. Published author zero-imputation reproduced separately only for author fidelity.
statistics: Unweighted mean of recorded daily percentages matches released figure fold. Sensitivity pools numerators/denominators on same valid days, and removes routing-anomaly dates. Report min/max descriptive daily range and matched-date IPv6-minus-IPv4 contrasts. No inferential CI: changing, clustered convenience panel and raw dependence structure unavailable.
algorithms_and_seeds: Deterministic arithmetic; RNG and orbital/terminal inputs inapplicable. Historical random representative-domain selection cannot be replayed without original selections.
controls: Counts finite/nonnegative/integer; statuses sum to cohort count; cohort partition equals all; grid and identity validation; numerator<=denominator where appropriate, TCP/UDP ratio can exceed100.
Execute AST-extracted original read_files with constrained filesystem adapter; compare independent summaries to original fold. Shared input summaries imply shared upstream aggregation assumptions.
coverage_limits: No new network measurements, packet-drop causal experiment, live operational validation or APNIC raw-data reanalysis.
No full raw-pcap replay: published daily volumes exceed local budget.
Server-IP denominators differ from NS-set outcome denominators; do not treat them as interchangeable.
Published revisions/2025 routes cannot be inferred from archive release timestamps.

applicability.equipment: BGP-controlled paths and historical operator policy unavailable; no fresh network campaign proposed
applicability.best_case_vs_budget: Census fixed archive window; no best-day selection; full raw replay outside150MB input budget
